description: JWT decoder, decode a JSON Web Token and check expiry. Decode a JSON Web Token: header, payload (claims) and readable issued, not-before and expiry times, and whether it has expired. Decode only: the signature is NOT verified, so do not trust the claims for security decisions. Tokens are never stored or logged. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
name: jwt_decode
